en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al Washa, from Aban, from Zurara, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>

having said: ‘Aliasws performed Ablution (Wudhu), so heasws washed hisasws face, and hisasws forearm. Then heasws wiped upon hisasws head, and upon hisasws slipper (open from the front), and did not enter hisasws hand beneath the straps’.
en.sarwar: 11. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu‘alla’ ibn Muhammad from al-Washsha’ from Aban from Zurarah who has said the following: “Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘

Ali, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, once took Wudu’. He washed his face and forearms, then wiped on top of his head and over his shoes but he did not push his hand under his shoelaces.’” (Fatwa best explains this Hadith.)
